issues.reason: Rising is distributive (each wraith rises separately), and the instruction set states without qualification that a distributive predicate over a plural OR GROUP also hands the predication to the members via a (PartOf $x <group>) rule — the bare-plural-episodic passage settles only that the subject is a group witness rather than a kind-ranging generic, not that the per-member rule lapses.

gaps_confirmed: A reduplicated iterative adverbial ('again and again') on an episodic clause: the unary (Again e) records only that a prior same-type event occurred, and no licensed head carries the repeated multiplicity (Every/TimesPer need a stated period or rate; the frequency dial is generic/habitual only).
defect_summary: The compliant form adds, beside the group-level rise event, (Implication (PartOf $x sk_group_1) (And (Member (sk_rise $x) rise) (Agent (sk_rise $x) $x) (Past (sk_rise $x)))) at (STV 1.0 0.9).
notes: Name/kind handling of 'the Stilllight Lantern', the no-Name default for 'the Council', the past-perfect Before ordering and the main-clause-first Because atom are all correct, and (Again sk_rise_1) under-records the iterative without asserting anything false.
